segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Okay, hiring sync. We have three open roles, two backend and one product designer.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Let's start with backend, that's where I'm feeling the pain.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Sure. We finished the final rounds for Ananya Ghosh and Joel Rebello last week.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Ananya was strong. Her system design answer was the best we've seen this year.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: I sat in on the culture round with her. Very clear communicator.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: What is she asking for?

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Twenty six lakh. She's at twenty one right now.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: Our band for that level tops out at twenty four.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Can we stretch? Good backend people are hard to find right now.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: Not above the band without the CFO, and that takes weeks.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: From her conversations, I think she'd accept twenty four with the joining bonus.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: A joining bonus of one lakh is within policy.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Then let's do it. We make Ananya an offer at twenty four lakh plus a one lakh joining bonus.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: Fine by me, that's inside the band.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Great. I'll send Ananya the offer letter by the end of the month.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Good. The sooner the better, she has another offer.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Also her notice period ends on 15 December, so she'd join after that.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: That's before the holidays at least.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: What about Joel?

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Mixed feedback. Coding was fine, design round was weak.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Let's not rush him. We still have two more candidates for the second backend seat.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Right, Pranav and Swati. Both cleared the coding test, they need the system-design round.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: I'll schedule the system-design round for both of them next Thursday.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Thanks Siddharth. I'll share their profiles with you today.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: Okay, designer role. I've seen eleven portfolios, two were worth a call.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: I'd like to give the shortlisted designers a paid take-home task. It shows far more than a portfolio.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: Paid how much? We don't have a line for that.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: Maybe five thousand per candidate.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Candidates have dropped out before when we asked for take-homes.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Let's not add the paid task right now. Let's see how the two calls go first.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: Okay, I'll leave the paid task out for now.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: Honestly, there's a bigger question on the designer seat. The Q4 budget has room for only one more hire.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Then backend comes first. The roadmap needs it more.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: I don't love it, but I understand.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: So the designer hire is paused until January, when the new budget opens.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: I'll tell the two candidates we'll get back in January.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: Please keep them warm, they were good.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Something else. The backend job post still mentions the old office in Andheri.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Oh, I hadn't noticed that.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: We need to refresh the job post. New office, and the hybrid policy.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: Not finance's job, I'll say that before anyone looks at me.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: Somebody from my side or yours, let's see who gets to it first.

segments.speaker: Maria Fernandes
segments.text: One idea for later is a referral bonus. Our own people know good engineers.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: There is already a referral policy, nobody reads it.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: That's fair. I'll put it in the next all-hands slide.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Anything else on the pipeline?

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: The interview calendar is getting crowded, so please accept invites quickly.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Point taken, I was slow last week.

segments.speaker: Harish Kumar
segments.text: Send me the final offer numbers so I can update the headcount sheet.

segments.speaker: Kavya Reddy
segments.text: I will copy you on the offer.

segments.speaker: Siddharth Bhatt
segments.text: Thanks everyone. Same time next week.

decisions.fact: Ananya Ghosh gets a backend offer at 24 lakh plus a 1 lakh joining bonus.
The product designer hire is on hold until January.

action_items.fact: Kavya sends the offer letter to Ananya.
action_items.due_phrase: by the end of the month

action_items.fact: Siddharth schedules system-design rounds for Pranav and Swati.
The backend job post is updated with the new office and hybrid policy; nobody owns it.

distractors.fact: A paid take-home task for designer candidates was suggested and dropped.
15 December is the end of Ananya's notice period, not the offer letter date.
